fields.option_statement: Close the inner lane of Dock Road for 25 days to build a bike lane.
fields.mechanism: The road works office closes one lane in phases and keeps a lane open for traffic.
fields.authority_and_legal_basis: A closure under thirty days needs no ministerial order under the invented statutes of Fiktiva.

how_it_meets_stage_criteria.how: The bike lane is open and counted on the public sheet after 25 days.

fields.risks_and_rights_impact: Traffic slows on two days. A lane stays open for emergency vehicles.
lawful_alternatives: Paint a shared lane without a closure.
assumptions: I assume the closure can be phased.

fields.change_summary: Ask posters for the place at ward level, not street level.
fields.reason: Three audit findings in the simulation show street names let people be identified.
fields.expected_flips: Posts naming a street would be held, not published.
fields.rollback_plan: Revert to the previous pack version.
fields.who_is_affected: Everyone posting a first problem in one region.
fields.lawful_basis: The pack privacy rule PRIV-GATE-1; unverified beyond that.
fields.risks: Some real problems may be held back at first.
